μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’) · also μένω — stay, stand firm; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stand!’ (ἠὲ μέν’ ’either stand’)
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’ · also periphrasis for a person, nom. subject: ’the strong might of Leonteus’ = mighty Leonteus
μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. (μή … δευοίατο ’lest they lack’) · also ’lest’ with a dual verb in -ετον: ’lest the two … hang back’ · also the negative of an infinitive in an oath: ’never to’ (μή ποτε … ἐπιβήμεναι) · also ’lest’ with a fut. indic., fear: ’lest he be angered’ (μή πως … κεχολώσεται)
μίμνεν: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, remain, wait; impf. 3 sg., epic unaugmented, with ν-movable (= Attic ἔμενε): ’stayed’
μακρὸν: μακρός — long, tall, high; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ὄλυμπον · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with ἄϋσεν: ’loudly’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δόρυ: ’long (spear)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὀχῆα: ’long’ (μακρὸν ὀχῆα ’the long bar’)
μεγάλην: μέγας — great, big; fem. acc. sg.: ’great (voice)’ · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἠϊόνα: ’great (beach)’
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μητέρος: μήτηρ — mother; fem. gen. sg., epic -έρος (= Attic μητρός)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μνησάμενος: μιμνῄσκω — remind; mid. remember, call to mind; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having remembered’
μνῆσαι: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, be mindful (+ gen.); aor. imper. mid. 2 sg.: ’remember!’
μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μοῦνος: μόνος (epic/Ionic μοῦνος) — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
μυρμιδόνες: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, the people of Achilles; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Myrmidons!’
μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’) · also a pledge, promise (τὸν μῦθον ὑπέστημεν ’the promise we undertook’)
νέον: νέος — young, new; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’lately, just now’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἄλγος: ’new’ (νέον ἔσσεται ἄλγος ’a new pain will be’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicate: ’young’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, agreeing with ἔργον: ’new’ (οὔ τι νέον ’not at all new’)
νήεσσιν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νήεσσιν (= Attic ναυσί)
νεμεσσητὸν: νεμεσσητός — open to righteous blame, shameful; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’a thing to resent’
νεῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl. (= epic νηῶν)
νηδύος: νηδύς — belly, stomach; fem. gen. sg., with ἀντιάσειε
νηῒ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables)
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’) · also dat. of possession: ’his’ (οἱ ἵπποι ’his horses’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
οἴω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg., act. form (= ὀΐω; Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’ · also οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. dual οἴω, agreeing with the dual subject of οἴχεσθον: ’the two alone’
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg. · also οἶος printed for οἰός (οἶς) — sheep; gen. sg. οἰός: ’of a sheep’ (οἰὸς ἄωτος ’sheep’s wool’)
οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her, to himself’ · also masc. nom. pl. demonstrative, printed with this accent (= οἳ): ’they’ (οἷ δ’ ἐγρηγόρθασι)
οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg., correlative of τοῖος (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also neut. acc. sg. in an indirect exclamation: ’what (a thing)’ (οἷον ἔειπε ’what he said’) · also neut. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. as an exclamatory adverb: ’how’ (οἷον … θαυμάζομεν ’how we marvel’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’such as (my might) is’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with an unspoken με: ’such as (I was) when’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔρνος, correlative of τοῖον: ’such as (a shoot)’
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδῷ: οὐδός — threshold; masc. dat. sg., after ἐπί (with γήραος): ’on the threshold (of old age)’
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’all (the flesh)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject, agreeing with ἄλλα: ’all else’ (ἄλλά τε πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἤματα: ’all (days)’ (ἤματα πάντα ’all days’)
πάρα: παρά — beside, at hand; adv. with the accent drawn back (anastrophe) before a form of εἰμί: πάρα … εἰσι = πάρεισι ’are at hand’ · also πάρα = πάρεστι ’is at hand’, with ellipsis of the verb (τῷ … πάρα εἷς γε θεῶν ’beside him is one of the gods’) · also prep. + gen., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’from beside, from’ (γαμβροῖο πάρα ’from his son-in-law’) · also prep. + dat., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’by, beside’ (νηῒ πάρα ’by the ship’) · also prep. + acc., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’beside’ (ποταμὸν πάρα ’beside the river’) · also πάρα = πάρεισι, with a plural subject: ’are at hand’ (πάρα … ἄλλοι ’others are at hand’)
πάτρης: πάτρη (Attic πάτρα) — fatherland, native land; gen. sg., Ionic η for Attic ᾱ
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πέμψον: πέμπω — send, send on one’s way; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’send’
πανάποτμος: πανάποτμος — utterly ill-fated (πᾶν- + ἄποτμος ’unfortunate’); adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate with ἐγώ
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
παρὲξ: παρέξ — out beyond, past, outside; prep. + acc. (also an adverb)
πατρός: πατήρ — father; masc. gen. sg.: ’(my) father’s’ (πατρός τε μέγα κλέος ’my father’s great glory’); also gen. of comparison after ἀμείνων: ’than his father’
πείσεις: πείθω — persuade, win over; fut. 2 sg.
πεζὸς: πεζός — on foot; adj., masc. nom. sg.
πειρᾷ: πειράω — try, test; mid. make trial of; pres. 2 sg. mid./dep., contracted from πειράεαι (= πειρᾶσαι), + an indirect question: ’you try’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’) · also + gen. with λείπομαι: ’left over from’ (πολέμοιο περὶ … λίπωνται ’are left over from the war’)
πηλεΐωνι: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. dat. sg.
πηλεΐωνος: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. gen. sg., patronymic
πηληϊάδεω: Πηληϊάδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
ποίησαν: ποιέω — make, do; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐποίησαν): ’they made’
ποδώκεϊ: ποδώκης — swift-footed; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -εϊ (= Attic ποδώκει), agreeing with Πηλεΐωνι
ποθι: ποθι — somehow, somewhere; epic enclitic adv. (= Attic πού)
πολέας: πολύς — much, many; masc./fem. acc. pl., epic πολέας (= Attic πολλούς)
πολέες: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολέες (= Attic πολλοί)
πολλῶν: πολύς — much, many; gen. pl., of persons: ’of many (men)’
πομπὸν: πομπός — escort, guide, conductor; masc. acc. sg.
πομπὸς: πομπός — escort, guide, conductor; masc. nom. sg.
πονέοντο: πονέομαι — toil, labour, be busy; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (Attic ἐπονοῦντο), unaugmented
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’) · also prep. + acc., ’against, up to’ (ποτὶ δ’ αὐτὸν τεῖχος ἔδειμαν ’built a wall against it’) · also adv., ’besides’, hardly to be translated (ποτὶ βρόμος ’the roar besides’) · also prep. + gen., ’toward’ (ποτὶ πτόλιος ’toward the city’) · also prep. + acc., ’to, toward’ (ποτὶ γαῖαν ’to the earth’)
που: που — somewhere, anywhere; perhaps, I suppose; enclitic adv.
πρίαμον: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. acc. sg.
πρίαμος: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
πρίαμόν: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’) · also in πρὸς ἰθύ ’straight toward’, with ἰθύ adverbial · also + acc., ’against’ (πρὸς δαίμονα ’against a divinity’)
πρῴην: πρῴην — lately, a short time ago; adv.
πυκινοῖσι: πυκινός — thick, close-set, dense; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’) · also prep. + gen., ’by, beside’ (πὰρ ποταμοῖο ’by the river’) · also prep. + acc., ’beyond’ (πὰρ δύναμιν ’beyond one’s power’)
πᾶσαν: πᾶς — all, every, whole; fem. acc. sg.
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison: ’than you’ · also possessive gen.: ’your’ · also gen. sg. after εἵνεκα: ’because of you’ · also gen. sg. after ἄρξομαι: ’from you’ (σέο … ἄρξομαι ’I shall begin from you’) · also gen. sg. after ἕξεται: ’on you’ (σέο … ἕξεται ’will rest on you’) · also gen. sg. after ἐκ: ’from you’ (σέο δ’ ἐκ ’and from you’)
σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ), after περί: ’about you’ · also gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than you’ (σεῖο … ὀλοώτερος ’deadlier than you’) · also gen. governed by εἵνεκα: ’on your account’ (εἵνεκα σεῖο) · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’away from you’ · also gen. object of μεθήσω: ’let go of you’ (σεῖο μεθήσω ’I will not give you up’) · also gen. sg. of source after ἐξ: ’from you’ · also gen. object of χατίζω: ’need of you’ · also gen. sg. after ἀντία: ’against you’ · also gen. sg. in a genitive absolute with καταφθιμένοιο: ’you having perished’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σοῖο: σός — your, yours; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic σοῦ)
σοῦ: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg.: ’of you, your’
στόμα: στόμα — mouth, face; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’mouth’ (κεφαλὴ στόμα τε ῥῖνές τε ’head and mouth and nostrils’) · also the point of a weapon: ’tip’ (κατὰ στόμα … χαλκῷ ’at the tip, with bronze’)
στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
σφι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. σφι: ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
σύν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat., accented before the enclitic τε that follows · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σύν ῥ’ ἔβαλον = συνέβαλον ’dashed together’)
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
σῆμα: σῆμα — sign, mark; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, with κικλήσκουσιν understood: ’tomb’ (σῆμα Μυρίνης ’the tomb of Myrine’) · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a token’ (σῆμα ἰδέσθαι ’to see the token’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’tomb’ (ἀνδρὸς τόδε σῆμα ’the tomb of a man’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of τιθείς: ’a sign, an omen’ · also neut. acc. sg., after παρά: ’tomb’ (παρ’ Ἴλου σῆμα ’past the tomb of Ilus’) · σῆμα — sign, tomb; neut. nom. sg., subject of a passive verb: ’tomb’ (σῆμα τετεύξεται ’a tomb will be made’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of τορνώσαντο and χεύαντες: ’the tomb’ · also neut. acc. sg., after περί: ’round the tomb’ (περὶ σῆμα ’round the tomb’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τάφρον: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. acc. sg.
τέκον: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτεκον): ’I bore’
τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., in apposition: ’young, offspring’ (τέκος ἐλάφοιο ’the young of a deer’) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’child’ (ἴδωμι φίλον τέκος)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆδος after εἴ: ’some’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει ’if some concern reaches you’) · also neut. acc. sg. indefinite, agreeing with ἔπος: ’some (word)’
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’) · also indefinite τίς with a noun in a question after ἦ: ’some’ (ἦ τίς … θεός ’or some god’) · also indefinite τίς after μή, before the enclitic οἱ: ’lest anyone’ (μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ’lest anyone go off’) · also indefinite τίς after εἴ ποτε, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’if ever anyone’ (εἴ ποτέ τίς τοι) · also indefinite τις, written τίς before the enclitic φησι: ’someone’ · also indefinite τίς with a noun, accented before an enclitic: ’some’ (κῆρύξ τίς … ’some herald’) · also indefinite τίς after εἰ, with ἄλλος: ’anyone (else)’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἦ ἄρ: ’at all, in any way’ (ἦ ἄρ τι … ἄρειον ’was it in any way better?’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with χρεώ after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τί … χρεώ ’nor any need’) · τις, τι — neut. acc. sg., agreeing with εἶδος after οὔτε: ’any’ (οὔτέ τι εἶδος ’nor any looks’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κακόν after δή: ’some (evil)’ (δή τι κακόν ’some evil’)
τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before an enclitic: ’a (man)’ · also masc. acc. sg. with a negative: ’no one’ (οὔ τινά φημι ’I say no one’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with μῆτιν: ’some’ · also fem. acc. sg. standing alone for an understood θεοπροπίην: ’some (prophecy)’ (καί τινά τοι … ἐπέφραδε ’and has pointed out some to you’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’) · also masc. acc. pl. in the correlative τοὺς μέν … τοὺς δέ: ’some … others’
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with them’ (ἅμα τοῖσι ’along with them’) · also neut. dat. pl. of things, after ἐπί: ’besides these, on top of these’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation, with ἀπέσσεσθαι: ’from it, from him’ · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, of separation after ἀπάνευθε: ’away from it’ · also masc. gen. sg. in a genitive absolute, of a stream: ’it’ (τοῦ … προρέοντος ’as it flows forward’) · also masc. gen. sg. of cause: ’on his account’ (τοῦ δὴ νῦν … φέρεις χάριν ’it is on his account that you bring favour’) · also masc. gen. sg., in a gen. absolute with ἑλκομένοιο: ’as he was dragged’ (τοῦ δ’ ἦν ἑλκομένοιο κονίσαλος) · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, after ἑκάτερθεν: ’of it’ (τοῦ ἑκάτερθεν ’on either side of it’) · also neut. gen. sg., of comparison: ’than it’ (τοῦ … μελάντερον ’blacker than it’) · also neut. gen. sg., governed by εἵνεκα: ’for the sake of this’
τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (same form)
τροίῃ: Τροίη — Troy; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Τροίᾳ)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg.: ’this’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (αἰσχρὸν τόδε ἐστί)
τόθ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τόθ’ = τότε)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τύνη: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., epic emphatic τύνη (= Attic σύ)
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), in a consequence: ’in that case, then’ (τώ κε … ἀντήσειε ’then would he meet’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’) · also fem. acc. sg. standing for a feminine thing: ’it’, in the correlative τὴν μέν … ’it, on the one hand’ · also fem. acc. sg. as a demonstrative for a feminine thing, object of ἔχων: ’this, it’ (τὴν … ἔχων ’holding it’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a participle: ’the (man) who’ (τὸν προὔχοντα ’the one ahead’) · also masc. acc. sg., article-like with an adjective and noun: ’the’ (τὸν δεξιὸν ἵππον ’the right-hand horse’) · also τὸν ἑόν, ’his own’ (τὸν ἑόν … Πόδαργον ’his own Podargus’)

ἀπήνης: ἀπήνη — mule-wagon, wagon; fem. gen. sg., after ἐπί: ’on the wagon’

ἐγών: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., epic form with ν (ἐγών = ἐγώ)
ἐδωδῆς: ἐδωδή — food, eating; fem. gen. sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’) · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
ἐλέησον: ἐλεέω — pity, have mercy on; aor. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’take pity on’
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμεῦ: ἐγώ — I; gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with δαήρ · also masc. nom. sg., agreeing with πάϊς: ’my own’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναίσιμα: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, auspicious (of signs); neut. acc. pl.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’ · ἐκ — in ἐξ ἄλλων (ἐκ + gen.), ’from among the others, more than the rest’
ἐξίκετο: ἐξικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg. mid., + acc.
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’) · also + dat. of aim: ’for, with a view to’ (ἐπ’ ἀρωγῇ ’for help’) · also + dat. of cause: ’at’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ γέλασσαν ’laughed at him’)
ἐπί: ἐπί — on, upon, towards; prep. + dat./acc./gen., accented before the enclitic τε; ἐπί τε … καί ’both to … and’ · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπί τ’ … ἠμύει ’bows down upon’)
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπελθὼν: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, come upon, advance against; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’advancing’
ἐπιείκελ: ἐπιείκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. voc. sg., elided (ἐπιείκελ’ = ἐπιείκελε)
ἐπιχθόνιος: ἐπιχθόνιος — upon the earth, earthly; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐριούνιος: ἐριούνιος — epithet of Hermes, conventionally ’helper’ or ’luck-bringer’ (by-form of ἐριούνης); masc. nom. sg.; the sense is disputed
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’) · also + gen., with δόμον understood: ’to the house of’ (ἐς Πριάμοιο ’to Priam’s’)
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἱπποπόλων Θρῃκῶν ’toward the horse-herding Thracians’) · also + acc., ’over’ (ἐφ’ ὑγρὴν ’over the water’)
ἐόντες: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντες): ’being’
ἐόντος: εἰμί — be; pres. part. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντος), in a gen. absolute with οὐκέτ’: ’being no more’
ἑοῦ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive, epic enlarged ἑός) — his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. ἑοῦ, agreeing with παιδός · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with πατρός: ’his own’ (ἑοῦ … πατρός ’of his own father’)
ἑρμείας: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; masc. nom. sg.
ἑτάροιο: ἕταρος — comrade, companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of cause after a verb of anger · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of cause after ἄχος: ’for the comrade’ (ἄχος … ἑτάροιο ’grief for the comrade’) · also masc. gen. sg., possessive, dependent on χερσί: ’of the companion’ · also masc. gen. sg., possessive, with ὀστέα: ’of the companion’ (ἑτάροιο ὀστέα ’the companion’s bones’)
ἑῆος: ἑός — one’s own (possessive of any person); masc. gen. sg., epic ἑῆος; sometimes taken as gen. of ἐύς ’good’
ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔλαθ: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); aor. 3 sg., elided ἔλαθε
ἔλασσαν: ἐλαύνω — drive; aor. 3 pl. act., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἤλασαν): ’they drove’
ἔλυσεν: λύω — loosen, unstring; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’loosened’ · also ’set free, released’ (a captive, for ransom)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔτλην: τλάω — endure, bear, suffer; aor. 1 sg.: ’I endured’ · also aor. 1 sg. + inf.: ’I dared, I brought myself to’
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’ · also impf. 3 sg., ’had as wife, was married to’ (θυγατέρα ἔχε ’had the daughter to wife’) · also impf. 3 sg., of a feeling: ’held, gripped’ (θάμβος δ’ ἔχε πάντας ’wonder held them all’)
ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
ἔχευε: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (contrast unaugmented χεῦεν/χεῦον of the same verb): ’poured’
ἔχουσι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they hold’
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕλκεα: ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic ἕλκη)
ἕλκει: ἕλκω — drag, draw; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’drags’
ἕταροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl., epic by-form ἕταροι (= ἑταῖροι)
ἠΰ: ἠΰς — good, noble (epic by-form of ἐΰς; Attic ἀγαθός); neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with μένος
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἠϋκόμοιο: ἠΰκομος (= ἐΰκομος) — fair-haired; adj. of two endings, fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Βρισηΐδος · also agreeing with Ἑλένης: ’fair-haired (Helen)’ · also agreeing with Θέτιδος: ’fair-haired (Thetis)’ · also agreeing with Ἀθηναίης: ’fair-haired (Athena)’ · also agreeing with Ἥρης: ’fair-haired (Hera)’
ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn, the goddess; fem. nom. sg. · also ἠώς — morning, dawn (the time of day, not the goddess); fem. nom. sg.: ’it was morning’ (ἠὼς ἦν)
ἡμιόνους: ἡμίονος — mule; masc. acc. pl.; accent from the enclitic τε
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’) · also ’than’ after φθάνω ’be first’ (φθήσονται … ἢ ὑμῖν ’will tire sooner than you’) · also ’rather than’ after βούλομαι (βουλοίμην … ἢ … ’I would rather … than …’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I came’ · also aor. 3 pl.: ’they came, advanced’
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg. · also masc. voc. sg., a courteous address: ’hero!’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj., epic by-form (variant accentuation ἦε), second member of an alternative question
ἰδαῖον: Ἰδαῖος — Idaeus, herald of Priam; masc. acc. sg., object of προσέφη
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; adv. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight on’ · also prep. + gen.: ’straight towards’
ἰόντα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going, as he goes’
ἰῆς: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. gen. sg., epic ἰῆς (= Attic μιᾶς), with στιχός: ’of the one (rank)’
ἱκάνω: ἱκάνω (poetic by-form of ἱκνέομαι) — come to, arrive at, reach; pres. 1 sg.
ἱκοίμην: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg., potential with κεν: ’I should come to’
ἴδοντο: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. 3 pl., epic, unaugmented (= augmented εἴδοντο): ’they saw’
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (short ι by metre; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented, which the spelling cannot show)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’) · also + opt., in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’so that … might’ (ἵνα μή … ἵκοιτο ’so that … might not come’)
ἵπποισι: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ὀλοῷ: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly, baneful; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with Ἀχιλῆϊ
ὀχῆας: ὀχεύς — bolt, bar; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic ὀχέας)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄζος: ὄζος — branch, shoot; fig. scion, offshoot; masc. nom. sg.
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄφρά: ὄφρα — so that, until, while; conj., epic (= Attic ἵνα, ἕως); with the subj.: ’so that’ (accent from the following enclitic) · also ὄφρα + indic., temporal: ’so long as’ (ὄφρά οἱ αἷμ’ … ἀνήνοθεν ’so long as the blood welled’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά σφιν … ῥύοιτο ’so that it might protect for them’)
ὄψεσθαι: ὁράω — see; fut. inf. mid. (ὄψομαι), in indirect speech after φησί: ’that he will see’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’) · also ὅς τις, indefinite relative + fut. indic.: ’whoever’ (ὅς τις … οἴσεται ’whoever will carry off’) · also ὅς τις, indefinite relative + opt.: ’whoever’ (ὅς τις … πέλοιτο ’whoever should prove’)
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as many as’
ὅτ: ὅτε — when; conj., elided (ὅτ’) · also ὡς ὅτ’, introducing a simile: ’as when’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also ὡς ὅτε, introducing a simile: ’as when’
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’) · also + gen., of entreaty: ’by’ (λίσσομ’ ὑπὲρ ψυχῆς ’I beseech by your life’) · also + gen. of place: ’beyond, across’ (ὑπὲρ ποταμοῖο ’across the river’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤϊξε: ὀΐγω (ἀνοίγω) — open; aor. 3 sg. act., epic ὤϊξε (= Attic ἀνέῳξε): ’opened’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μευ, ’that’, after a verb of remembering (ὥς μευ ἀεὶ μέμνησαι ’that you always remember me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic σφιν, temporal: ’when, as when’ (ὥς σφιν πρῶτον ἀπήχθετο ’when first it became hateful to them’)
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl. · also relative, fem. dat. pl.: ’for whom’ · also ἵημι — send, hurl, throw; aor. subj. 3 sg., contracted, epic -σι (ᾗσι = ἕῃσι): ’throws’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥῦσαι: ῥύομαι — rescue, deliver, protect (distinct from ἐρύω ’drag’); aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.: ’rescue!’
